item.title: The 2026 Whitney Biennial Delivers American Art for a Fractured Age
item.description: Across the Biennial, artists trace the afterlives of empire, technological distortion and ecological collapse—theirs is a world struggling to imagine the conditions of its own renewal.

item.title: Hanging by a Thread: Inside the Death-Defying World of Rappel Graffiti
item.description: "Painting on the rope is like a trip, a runner's high. You won't get it every single time, but you will be chasing it every time," street artist Zwon told Observer.

item.title: California’s Best Wine Regions—and How to Explore Them
item.description: Whether you like a French-style chardonnay with oaky undertones or a cherry-forward pinot with a little weight, we’re breaking down the basics on the very best of California’s renowned wine regions.

item.title: Julia Jo Paints at the Threshold of Emotion and Psychical Presence
item.description: In her latest exhibition at Charles Moffett, paintings reclaim their ancient function as manifestations of presence, perception and mythic imagination.

item.title: The Limited-Edition Lexus LC500 Inspiration: Unapologetically Impractical and Utterly Pleasurable
item.description: The LC500 is what they call an “emotional car,” and my primary emotion was “please don’t take it away from me at the end of the week.”

item.title: Can David Ellison Break Hollywood’s Mega-Merger Curse?
item.description: Paramount Skydance may soon own one of the deepest libraries in entertainment, but until it decides what kind of studio it wants to be, the merger risks becoming a very expensive identity crisis.

item.title: LeBron James, Tom Brady and Vegas’ Power Crowd Turn Out for Zero Bond’s Wynn Debut
item.description: Scott Sartiano's members' club debuts on the Strip with caviar cannolis, art on the walls and a Doja Cat performance.

item.title: Two Legendary Collections Are Set to Dominate New York’s May Marquee Auctions
item.description: Christie’s has secured a group of masterpieces once owned by media mogul S. I. Newhouse, while Sotheby’s will bring works from dealer Robert Mnuchin to the rostrum.

item.title: Palmer Luckey’s Nostalgic Gaming Side Hustle Is About to Become a Unicorn
item.description: The Anduril founder and Oculus creator brings his retro gaming dream to life as ModRetro eyes unicorn status with its Game Boy-inspired console.

item.title: ARCOmadrid Balances Curatorial Quality With an Easygoing Spirit
item.description: This European fair has long cultivated its reputation as a platform for encountering thoughtful work rather than a marketplace where well-heeled buyers chase high-priced trophies.
